other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Karnataka
Age limit: up to 21 years for undergraduate courses and up to 35 years for postgraduate/PhD courses
Must have scored at least 55% marks in qualifying exams for postgraduate/PhD courses or 80% in undergraduate qualifying exams
Must have cleared GRE/GMAT/TOEFL/IELTS with minimum required scores
Must have secured admission to a full‑time degree program at an overseas university/college
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance (up to 100% scholarship) for eligible SC/ST students to pursue overseas undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programs.
documents_required: Degree/Master Degree All Semester Marks Card
Tuition fee and maintenance fee as sent by the university
